pretreatments.description: Knife milling disassembles and breaks down feedstock into fine particles, enhancing biodegradability.
Hammer milling impacts feedstock fragments, improving digestibility through fragmentation.
Extrusion applies shear forces to break down feedstock into fine particles, aiding digestion.
Hydrodynamic cavitation induces microbubbles that disrupt feedstock structure, enhancing microbial activity.
